articles.summary: Gyre Pharmaceuticals completed a Pre-NDA meeting with China’s CDE, which agreed that the existing Phase 3 clinical data support a conditional approval filing for Hydronidone and priority review eligibility, subject to formal approval. articles.title: Gyre Therapeutics Announces Alignment with China’s CDE on Conditional Approval Pathway and Priority Review Eligibility for Hydronidone Following Pre-NDA Meeting
